name: Zul'Gurub: Bloodlord Mandokir whirls once every 25 seconds, in the charge's place when nobody is out of melee
contract: The live CoA combat log of 2026-08-02 (Normal kill) shows Mandokir's (11382) Whirlwind (2118408) every
25.0-25.2 s, also in cycles where he charges nobody; with a charge target it begins as the charge lands
(tester, 2026-11-04). With nobody out of melee he whirls in the charge's place, 10 s into the fight, so its
3 s cast ends by 14.5 s; the timer of the previous script began it at 12 s. An older script whirled twice per
25 s cycle. The hero stands in melee and stops attacking, so there is no charge target and no gaze punishment.

steps.label: CONTROL: the hero is in Zul'Gurub on Normal
DISCRIMINATING: the first Whirlwind begins in the charge's place, 10 s into the fight
Wait past the older script's second whirlwind 8 s after the charge
DISCRIMINATING: only one Whirlwind in the first 25 s cycle
DISCRIMINATING: the next Whirlwind comes 25 s after the first, with nobody charged
